name: VATLayer API
tagline: Real-time EU VAT rates and number validation for e-commerce checkout and tax compliance.
description: VATLayer provides a REST API for European VAT compliance: live VAT rates by country, VAT number validation against official registries, price calculation with VAT, and related tax helpers. It is commonly used by e-commerce platforms and billing systems to apply correct VAT at checkout and verify business VAT IDs. Access is via an access_key query parameter after free or paid signup on vatlayer.com.

auth.details: API access_key as a query parameter (access_key=YOUR_API_KEY). Self-serve signup at vatlayer.com; free and paid plans available.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 100 requests/month free (Free plan); higher tiers available
pricing.paid_plans: Paid plans from Basic (~$9.99/mo) upward with higher monthly request quotas; see pricing page for current tiers

rate_limits: Plan-based monthly request quotas; exact per-second rate limits not prominently published

use_cases: validate an EU VAT number for B2B checkout
fetch current VAT rate for a country code
calculate price including VAT for a given amount and country
look up VAT rate list for all EU member states
verify company name and address from a VAT ID
